featured_reviews.review_text:
If you truly want your wedding day to be smooth and perfect, I strongly advise you to think twice before trusting Gautam Wedding Events.
My experience with them was extremely disappointing and caused unnecessary stress on one of the most important days of my life.

I had booked 50 “Pheta” pieces at ₹100 each for a 12 PM delivery, and this booking was done one month in advance. I even paid 50% advance to confirm the order.

But on the day of my wedding:
•	They completely forgot they had to come to my place.
•	Only after I reminded them did they say the exact Pheta I booked was not available.
•	They kept promising they would arrange the same colour, but from 10 AM to 1:30 PM, while my function had already started, they still failed to provide anything.

From my experience, it became very clear that:
•	They do not own their items — they borrow from others and pass it to customers.
•	They were highly unprofessional in handling something so important.
•	The people coordinating with us were immature and lacked basic manners or civic sense.

Because of their mismanagement and false assurances, my father was deeply hurt, as his only wish was that all the Baraatis wear Pheta — something we had booked well in advance.

Instead of fixing the issue, their only solution was “Take your advance back”, as if we could magically arrange 50 Phetas at the last moment.

I am writing this review so others do not go through the same embarrassment and stress.
Sometimes paying ₹100 extra to a reliable vendor is far better than risking your special day with careless and unprofessional service providers.

This was my genuine experience, and I hope it helps someone else make a better decision.

featured_reviews.name: David McElhinney
featured_reviews.review_text:
We would whole-heartedly recommend using Namrata and the Two Fat Ladies team to help plan your wedding. As a Northern Irish and Indian couple, we were keen to work with planners that had experience planning intercultural marriages, and from the get-go we found Namrata diligent, communicative, approachable, and most importantly, always presenting a calming, relaxed demeanour. The last of these traits prevented the process from ever becoming too overwhelming. Her team, Cean and Vedika, were also fantastic and really helped during the planning process and ensured things moved smoothly on the days of the wedding. They all listened to what we wanted, offered great suggestions and insights, and helped make the wedding an unforgettable experience for us and all our guests.

Though we could cite lots of specific examples of why we were pleased with their work, one in particular stands out. On the day of the Sangeet, there was an unseasonal rain shower at our wedding venue in Goa. We had planned to hold the event on the hotel lawn, but with the rain showing no signs of abating, the Two Fat Ladies team were able to usher in some last-minute changes and stage it in a nearby hall, moving all of the décor, furniture, catering facilities, and DJ equipment (not to mention our guests) into a building that didn’t feel big enough to accommodate it all, shouldering the burden of that stress all the while. The transformation inside the hall was incredible; it was hard to believe it was the same featureless room we had viewed during a hotel visit several months earlier.

You may ask yourself if you even need a planner. Yes, you do. The Two Fat Ladies were worth their weight in gold.

With that, just check the length of reviews 2fatLadies have across media.
You’ll find how much people loved working with them. The common feedback for this team is the “Will be done” attitude, the “calm/happy vibes” that this team brings in, the meticulous OCD manner in which they operate.

Personally, I had hired this team for my wedding. You don’t need to be Mumbai based to enjoy working with them. Their service quality isn’t dependent on proximity to their home base.

What I absolutely adore about her is her ability to listen, process and in most cases somehow read your mind.
I have attached few pictures of what I wanted for my decor - it is going to be hard for you to find which one was my inspo pic and which one is my actual wedding decor - that’s the level they operate at.

Cean - She was my shadow to help w/ the wedding stuff. What ab absolute treat this young lady is. I personally got to learn so much from her all throughout the wedding. How to be polite, push back to vendors, be SUPER calm and incredibly sweet to people while also being a kickass boss lady. She doesn’t need to be told what to do - she just does it pro-actively. A quality I admire so much in her.

The team - thoughtful, kind, warm and professional.

I just cannot recommend them enough.
Just go ahead and book them, you won’t regret.
- Sonakshi

For us it was important to choose a planner that knows the industry, is organized and most importantly can work with people that live abroad, as we live in Switzerland. And clearly the Two Fat Ladies fulfilled all these criteria.

The entire planning process was pleasant and accompanied by unwavering commitment and determination by the Two Fat Ladies to ensure we would get our dream wedding. Be it through having meetings at any given time (due to the time difference), negotiating with vendors and bringing us the best possible deal out there, and meticulously keeping track of expenses. I cannot thank Events by TWD enough for the amazing job they did in planning and executing our wedding. I’ve attached some photos here, because words honestly don’t do justice to how beautifully they brought our vision to life.

What impressed me most was how punctual, well-coordinated, and calm the entire team was throughout. Every single ritual item, return gift, and element needed for each ceremony was perfectly in place, on time, and handled with such professionalism. They never missed a beat.

One of the most important moments for me was the Varmala ceremony — I wanted it to happen exactly at the muhurat time, and the team ensured it was executed with perfect timing. That level of attention to detail really meant a lot to me.

All the team members were extremely polite, approachable, and respectful — not just with us but with our families and guests too. They truly made our wedding stress-free, smooth, and memorable. I’m genuinely so happy with the decision to go with Events by TWD as our wedding planners.

If you’re looking for a team that listens, understands your vision, and delivers with warmth and professionalism — look no further. Thank you, TWD, for giving us the wedding of our dreams! 💛

— Ketaki & Alok
